internal_metric.adaptive_rule: recompute in the same PR as the input change; overwrite in place; computed_at >= latest input change or stale
adaptive_triggers: any v2 score record added/updated for the event (ours or field)
our submission state or our score change
computation: 1. Realized: event closed with recorded outcome (e.g. not_submitted) -> estimate = realized (0), range [0,0], confidence high.
2. No sourced denominator -> estimate null, range null, confidence none (no prior exists; a number would be invented).
3. Prior: base_rate b = award_slots_top / denominator (denominator per event as recorded: submitted projects where established, else participants). The base rate is ONLY a prior in v2.

4. Standing update (odds form): odds = b/(1-b) x LR_standing x LR_fit; estimate = odds/(1+odds). LR_standing from our v2 composite percentile s among scored field composites (Laplace s = (below + 0.5*ties + 0.5)/(n+1); LR = clamp(s/(1-s), 0.1, 10)). LR_fit = clamp(our criteria/judge-fit axis / field mean of same axis, 0.5, 2) when both exist, else 1 with fit unknown. No our_composite yet -> both LRs = 1, estimate = prior.

5. Uncertainty interval (never silently a point): unknowns u = unscored_share = 1 - scored_count/denominator, v = unverified_axis_weight_share from our v2 record (record absent -> v = 1). k = clamp(0.6u + 0.4v, 0.05, 0.95); range = [estimate*(1-k), min(1, estimate*(1+k))]. confidence: k < 0.30 high, k < 0.65 medium, else low.
